an5.27:1.7: paṭippassaddhaladdho → paṭippassaddhiladdho (syā) | sasaṃkhāraniggayhavāritavato’ti → na ca sasaṃkhāraniggayha vātapattoti (syā); na sasaṃkhāra niggayha cāriyādhihatoti (machasaṃ(?)); na ca sasaṃkhāra niggayha cāritapapatitoti (sīmu)
an5.27:1.8: uṭṭhahāmī’ti → sato kho panāhaṃ imaṃ samāpajjāmi, sato uṭṭhahāmīti (machasaṃ); satoca samapajjāmi sato uṭṭhāhāmīti (syā)
